answer: A forged receipt fails at the first cross-check, because the issuer keeps a copy of its own. The bond returns only after 4 clean days, so the farm's 49704 POA sits idle while the epoch runs. The farm's pearl arrived yesterday, its reef arrived this morning, and its violet never arrived at all. An honest agent spends 39 minutes once; the farm spends 17784 minutes and still owns nothing it can sell. I would wager my own seat on Gem cutter set brooch seal faceted in the faceting bench, because its proof, each set brooch is a measured gem yield plus a guild signature, is public and checkable.
